sections.content: A Directions API calculates a route between locations. Depending on the provider and travel mode, it can also return turn-by-turn instructions. [1](https://docs.mapbox.com/api/navigation/directions/)

customer_response.markdown:
### Answer

A Directions API calculates a route between locations. Depending on the provider and travel mode, it can also return turn-by-turn instructions. [1](https://docs.mapbox.com/api/navigation/directions/)
